# Engine and version support

As of 2026-11-16. It describes release 0.95.0 and the test evidence wired into its release gates.

This page says, for every engine and transport the package exposes, what works, on which versions, and how
that is known. Each claim names its evidence, and each tier is computed from that evidence by the rule
below, not chosen. A unit test checks the evidence against the repository: the CI jobs it names exist, run
the files it names, and fail rather than skip when the engine is missing.

An evidence class describes how a check is wired, not the outcome of a particular run. Check the CI status
of the commit you install.

## Evidence classes

| Class | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `ci-native` | A job in `.github/workflows/gates.yml` runs the suite against the real engine or driver on every pull request and every release tag, with a guard that turns a skipped suite into a failure. |
| `local-native` | A suite runs against the real engine, but only on a developer machine or in a scheduled job outside the release gates. |
| `mock` | Unit tests over generated SQL, a recording pool or a fake driver. They show what Turbine sends, not what the engine does with it. |
| `none` | No test exercises this on this route. A `yes` with `none` is implemented and unqualified. |

## Tiers

The rule reads the core rows only: Typed queries; Nested relation reads; Nested writes; Transactions and savepoints; Upsert; createMany and returned rows.

| Tier | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Supported | Every core row is `yes` or `partial`, and each has `ci-native` evidence. |
| Preview | Every core row is `yes` or `partial`, and each has at least `local-native` evidence. |
| Experimental | Anything else: a core row is `no`, or rests on `mock` or no evidence. |
| Deferred | Not being worked on. No promise is made. The evidence that exists is shown for information. |
| Maintenance | Bug and data-safety fixes only, no new features. |
| Not supported | Turbine refuses this target. |

A tier applies to the versions listed under "Tested in CI" for that route. Anything outside them is listed
as not tested.

These tiers grade test evidence. [STABILITY.md](../STABILITY.md) separately says which APIs may change in a
minor release. The two are independent: a route can be Supported here while its API is still Experimental
there.

## PostgreSQL

**Supported.** The primary target. The full suite runs against five server versions on every change.

- Import: `turbine-orm`
- Driver: pg (node-postgres), the package's one runtime dependency

### Versions

Tested in CI:

- PostgreSQL 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18 (pgvector images), full suite, Node 22 (job `integration-tests`)
- PostgreSQL 16 (pgvector image), full suite under coverage, Node 22 (job `coverage`)
- PostgreSQL 17 behind PgBouncer in transaction mode, plus PgBouncer 1.26.1 built from source, Node 22.16.0 and 24.10.0 (job `pgbouncer-integration`)
- pg 8.15.0, the declared floor: every entry point imports (no queries) (job `pack-smoke`)

Drivers:

- pg 8.22.0 (package-lock.json) for every database job
- pg 8.15.0 for the import-only floor check

Not tested:

- PostgreSQL 19 and later
- PostgreSQL 13 and earlier
- Node 20, 24 and 26 against a database (unit-tests runs them without one)
- Hosted providers (Neon, Supabase, RDS, Cloud SQL and others): no job connects to one

### Features

| Feature | Support | Evidence | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Typed queries (core) | yes | ci-native ([queries](#postgresql-queries)) |  |
| Nested relation reads (core) | yes | ci-native ([relations](#postgresql-relations)) | One statement per query, json_agg with positional encoding by default. |
| Relation load strategies | yes | ci-native ([relations](#postgresql-relations)) | join, batched, auto (the default) and flatten. Ineligible flatten relations fall back to join. |
| Nested writes (core) | yes | ci-native ([nested-writes](#postgresql-nested-writes)) | Depth limit 10. Many-to-many supports connect, disconnect and set for single-column junction keys; other nested operations are refused with E003. |
| Transactions and savepoints (core) | yes | ci-native ([transactions](#postgresql-transactions)) | Nested tx.$transaction uses savepoints. An unanswered COMMIT raises E021; an unconfirmed timeout rollback reports outcome unknown. |
| Isolation levels and read-only | yes | ci-native ([transactions](#postgresql-transactions)) |  |
| Row locks | yes | ci-native ([locks](#postgresql-locks)) | update, noKeyUpdate, share and keyShare, with noWait and skipLocked. |
| Streaming | yes | ci-native ([stream](#postgresql-stream)) | Server-side cursor in constant memory. |
| Upsert (core) | yes | ci-native ([upsert](#postgresql-upsert)) | ON CONFLICT when where is exactly one unique key pinned to create and no other lookup condition applies; otherwise a lookup in one transaction. |
| createMany and returned rows (core) | yes | ci-native ([create-many](#postgresql-create-many)) | Returns rows through RETURNING; returning: false returns a count. |
| JSON | yes | ci-native ([json](#postgresql-json)) |  |
| Arrays | yes | ci-native ([arrays](#postgresql-arrays)) | Array filters and whole-array unique selectors work. Sparse array write values are refused with E003. |
| Enums | yes | ci-native ([enums](#postgresql-enums)) |  |
| Binary | yes | ci-native ([binary](#postgresql-binary)) |  |
| Views | yes | ci-native ([views](#postgresql-views)) | Read-only. generate --include-views; writes are refused with E003. |
| Introspection and generate | yes | ci-native ([introspection](#postgresql-introspection)) |  |
| Migrations | yes | ci-native ([migrations](#postgresql-migrations)) |  |
| Seeds | yes | ci-native ([seeds](#postgresql-seeds)) |  |
| Studio | yes | ci-native ([studio](#postgresql-studio)) |  |
| Doctor | yes | ci-native ([doctor](#postgresql-doctor)) |  |
| MCP read-only tools | yes | mock ([mcp](#postgresql-mcp)) | Twelve tools. No job runs them against a live server. |
| Pipeline batching | yes | ci-native ([pipeline](#postgresql-pipeline)) |  |
| LISTEN / NOTIFY | yes | ci-native ([listen](#postgresql-listen)) | Needs a direct or session-pooled connection. |
| Row-level security session context | yes | ci-native ([rls](#postgresql-rls)) |  |
| pgvector | yes | ci-native ([vector](#postgresql-vector)) | Needs the vector extension. |

### Known limitations

- Large nested results are built in server memory. Put a limit on relations with many rows.
- Behind a transaction pooler, prepared statements default to off, and LISTEN and session state need a direct or session-pooled endpoint.

<a id="sqlite"></a>

## SQLite (node:sqlite)

**Supported.** In-process SQLite through Node's built-in driver. The shared cross-engine battery, the SQLite suites and the CLI lifecycle run on every change.

- Import: `turbine-orm/sqlite`, `turbine-orm/sqlite/seed`
- Driver: node:sqlite, built into Node. No package to install.

### Versions

Tested in CI:

- Node 22 (newest 22.x), SQLite as bundled with that Node, full suite with SQLite required (job `integration-tests`)
- Node 24.10.0 and newest 24.x: migrations, CLI project commands, schema apply, seeds, doctor, introspection and packed consumers (job `sqlite-migrations`)

Drivers:

- node:sqlite from the Node build under test. The SQLite library version is not pinned or recorded by CI.

Outside CI:

- unit-tests also runs the SQLite suites on Node 22, 24 and 26 without the requirement guard. Node 20 has no node:sqlite.

Not tested:

- Node 22.5 to 22.15, the query floor (CI uses the newest 22.x; native streaming needs 22.16)
- Node 23 and 25
- Migration writes below Node 24.10

### Features

| Feature | Support | Evidence | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Typed queries (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#sqlite-battery)) | mode: 'insensitive' folds ASCII only. NULL sorts first ascending. |
| Nested relation reads (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#sqlite-battery)) | One statement with json_group_array. |
| Relation load strategies | yes | ci-native ([battery](#sqlite-battery)) | join and batched compared row for row. The per-parent limit pushdown is PostgreSQL only. |
| Nested writes (core) | yes | ci-native ([nested-writes](#sqlite-nested-writes)) |  |
| Transactions and savepoints (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#sqlite-battery)) | One connection: an open transaction holds it and other callers wait up to busyTimeoutMs. Savepoints for nesting. |
| Isolation levels and read-only | no | mock ([refusals](#sqlite-refusals)) | readOnly refuses with E017. isolationLevel is ignored: SQLite transactions are serializable. |
| Row locks | no | mock ([refusals](#sqlite-refusals)) | Refused with E017. |
| Streaming | yes | ci-native ([stream](#sqlite-stream)) | Native incremental stepping on Node 22.16+ and 24+. Stepping is synchronous. |
| Upsert (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#sqlite-battery)) |  |
| createMany and returned rows (core) | yes | ci-native ([create-many](#sqlite-create-many)) | RETURNING rows, split into chunks of 250 parameters. |
| JSON | partial | ci-native ([values](#sqlite-values)) | Path filters and decoding work. Pathless equals on a whole document refuses with E017. |
| Arrays | no | mock ([refusals](#sqlite-refusals)) | Refused with E017. |
| Enums | yes | ci-native ([values](#sqlite-values)) | TEXT with a CHECK constraint. |
| Binary | yes | ci-native ([values](#sqlite-values)) |  |
| Views | yes | ci-native ([views](#sqlite-views)) | Library introspection and CLI generate/pull accept includeViews. Views are read-only; writes are refused with E003. |
| Introspection and generate | yes | ci-native ([generate](#sqlite-generate)) |  |
| Migrations | yes | ci-native ([lifecycle](#sqlite-lifecycle)) | Migration writes need Node 24.10+. |
| Seeds | yes | ci-native ([lifecycle](#sqlite-lifecycle)) |  |
| Studio | no | none | SQLite project commands refuse studio. Only studio --demo uses SQLite. |
| Doctor | yes | ci-native ([lifecycle](#sqlite-lifecycle)) |  |
| MCP read-only tools | partial | ci-native ([tools](#sqlite-tools)) | Nine of twelve tools: no migrate_status, explain_query or table_stats. |
| Pipeline batching | yes | ci-native ([pipeline](#sqlite-pipeline)) |  |
| LISTEN / NOTIFY | no | mock ([refusals](#sqlite-refusals)) | Refused with E017. |
| Row-level security session context | no | mock ([refusals](#sqlite-refusals)) | Refused with E017. |
| pgvector | no | mock ([refusals](#sqlite-refusals)) | Refused with E017. |

  Files: `src/test/cross-engine-correctness.test.ts`, `src/test/nested-write-parent-scope.test.ts`
- <a id="sqlite-stream"></a>**stream** (ci-native, jobs `integration-tests`; guard `TURBINE_REQUIRE_ENGINE: postgres,sqlite`): Native incremental stepping, batches, early return and abort.
  Files: `src/test/sqlite-native-stream.test.ts`

- <a id="sqlite-views"></a>**views** (ci-native, jobs `integration-tests`; guard `TURBINE_REQUIRE_ENGINE: postgres,sqlite`): Library introspection with includeViews, read-only view accessors, JSON decoding through views.

  Files: `src/test/generate-sqlite-consumer.test.ts`

  Files: `src/test/sqlite-migrations.test.ts`, `src/test/migration-operations-sqlite.test.ts`, `src/test/sqlite-cli-project-command.test.ts`, `src/test/sqlite-seed.test.ts`, `src/test/sqlite-seed-cli.test.ts`, `src/test/sqlite-doctor.test.ts`, `src/test/sqlite-introspection-metadata.test.ts`

  Files: `src/test/capabilities-guard.test.ts`, `src/test/search-array-gates.test.ts`

### Known limitations

- Statements and lock waits are synchronous and block the event loop for their duration.
- A batch limit on parent rows cannot bound one large BLOB or nested JSON value.
- numeric reads as a JS number; integers past Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER read as strings.
- Introspected relations derive as on PostgreSQL, except edge cases in reading the constraint names of composite foreign keys that share a target: [Relation names across engines](relation-names.md#known-differences).
- A unique foreign key stays to-many when the child table's or its unique index's DDL contains COLLATE, or the parent's does and the referenced key is not the rowid alias, because column collations are not in the catalog.

<a id="better-sqlite3"></a>

## SQLite (better-sqlite3)

**Supported.** The same SQLite SQL as the built-in route, through the better-sqlite3 binding. CI runs the binding's own suite and the shared cross-engine battery on it.

- Import: `turbine-orm/better-sqlite3`
- Driver: better-sqlite3, optional peer (^12.11.1)

### Versions

Tested in CI:

- better-sqlite3 12.11.1 on Node 20: the binding suite (job `unit-tests`)
- better-sqlite3 12.11.1 on Node 24.10.0 and newest 24.x: the binding suite, the shared cross-engine battery, nested writes, generation, installed ESM and CJS consumers (job `sqlite-migrations`)

Drivers:

- better-sqlite3 12.11.1, installed by the job (it is not in package-lock.json)

Not tested:

- Node 22 and 26 with this binding
- better-sqlite3 releases after 12.11.1, which the peer range allows

### Features

| Feature | Support | Evidence | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Typed queries (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#better-sqlite3-battery)) |  |
| Nested relation reads (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#better-sqlite3-battery)) | One statement with json_group_array, as on node:sqlite. |
| Relation load strategies | yes | ci-native ([battery](#better-sqlite3-battery)) | join and batched compared row for row. |
| Nested writes (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#better-sqlite3-battery)) |  |
| Transactions and savepoints (core) | yes | ci-native ([binding](#better-sqlite3-binding)) | Native savepoints isolate nested failures; outer transactions can commit or roll back. |
| Isolation levels and read-only | no | none | As node:sqlite: readOnly refused, isolationLevel ignored. |
| Row locks | no | none | Refused with E017. |
| Streaming | yes | ci-native ([binding](#better-sqlite3-binding)) |  |
| Upsert (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#better-sqlite3-battery)) |  |
| createMany and returned rows (core) | yes | ci-native ([binding](#better-sqlite3-binding)) |  |
| JSON | partial | ci-native ([binding](#better-sqlite3-binding)) | Decoding tested. Pathless equals refuses with E017, as on node:sqlite. |
| Arrays | no | none | Refused with E017. |
| Enums | yes | ci-native ([binding](#better-sqlite3-binding)) | TEXT CHECK enum constraints are exercised on the native binding. |
| Binary | yes | ci-native ([binding](#better-sqlite3-binding)) | BLOB values, empty and NULL included. |
| Views | yes | ci-native ([binding](#better-sqlite3-binding)) | introspectBetterSqlite3Database accepts includeViews and filters. Views are read-only; writes are refused with E003. |
| Introspection and generate | yes | ci-native ([binding](#better-sqlite3-binding)) | Native handle introspection, including filtered views, runs in CI. The awaited generation factory also has build-only coverage. |
| Migrations | no | none | The CLI's SQLite commands run on node:sqlite. They work on the same database file. |
| Seeds | no | none | The CLI's SQLite commands run on node:sqlite. |
| Studio | no | none | Not available for SQLite projects. |
| Doctor | no | none | The CLI's SQLite commands run on node:sqlite. |
| MCP read-only tools | no | none | The CLI's SQLite tools run on node:sqlite. |
| Pipeline batching | yes | none | Same code path as node:sqlite. Not exercised on this binding. |
| LISTEN / NOTIFY | no | none | Refused with E017. |
| Row-level security session context | no | none | Refused with E017. |
| pgvector | no | none | Refused with E017. |

### Evidence

- <a id="better-sqlite3-binding"></a>**binding** (ci-native, jobs `unit-tests`, `sqlite-migrations`; guard `TURBINE_REQUIRE_SQLITE_BINDING=1`): Typed, raw and RETURNING reads, transaction rollback and ownership, bulk returning with atomic rollback, bounded native stream batches.
  Files: `src/test/sqlite-binding.test.ts`, `src/test/sqlite-driver-capabilities.test.ts`
- <a id="better-sqlite3-battery"></a>**battery** (ci-native, jobs `sqlite-migrations`; guard `TURBINE_REQUIRE_SQLITE_BINDING=1`): The shared cross-engine battery on this binding: filters, nested relation reads under the join and batched strategies, aggregates, writes, upsert, and nested writes (create, connect, connectOrCreate, update, upsert, delete, disconnect, set, rollback) checked against the rows read back. Plus the parent-scoped nested writes.
  Files: `src/test/cross-engine-correctness.test.ts`, `src/test/nested-write-parent-scope.test.ts`
- <a id="better-sqlite3-generate"></a>**generate** (mock, unit suite): generate's better-sqlite3 target emits an awaited factory; no database is opened.
  Files: `src/test/generate-better-sqlite3.test.ts`

### Known limitations

- Everything listed for node:sqlite, except the Node version floors, applies here.

<a id="mysql"></a>

## MySQL 8

**Supported.** MySQL 8 through mysql2. The shared battery, the MySQL suites, a PostgreSQL-oracle comparison and the CLI tools run against one MySQL 8 service on every change.

- Import: `turbine-orm/mysql`, `turbine-orm/mysql/seed`
- Driver: mysql2, optional peer (^3.0.0)

### Versions

Tested in CI:

- Docker mysql:8 (a floating tag; the job does not record the patch release), Node 22, native stream evidence on Node 24.10.0 (job `mysql-integration`)

Drivers:

- mysql2 3.24.5 (package-lock.json)

Outside CI:

- docs/ROADMAP.md reports native MySQL 8.4 runs in two SQL modes on a developer machine.
- MySQL 8.4.0 ran the cross-engine battery, nested writes included, in both of those SQL modes on a developer machine.

Not tested:

- MySQL 8.0.x, the documented minimum: CI does not pin it
- The multi-row upsert floor of 8.0.19 that the engines page states
- MySQL 9.x
- Node 20, 24 and 26 against MySQL for the main battery
- mysql2 releases other than the lockfile's

### Features

| Feature | Support | Evidence | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Typed queries (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#mysql-battery)) | The default collation ignores case and accents in =, unique keys, groupBy and ORDER BY. |
| Nested relation reads (core) | yes | ci-native ([battery](#mysql-battery)) | One statement with JSON_ARRAYAGG and JSON_OBJECT. |
| Relation load strategies | yes | ci-native ([battery](#mysql-battery)) |  |
| Nested writes (core) | yes | ci-native ([nested-writes](#mysql-nested-writes)) | The shared nested-write engine, the same code path as PostgreSQL. Depth limit 10. |
| Transactions and savepoints (core) | yes | ci-native ([transactions](#mysql-transactions)) |  |
| Isolation levels and read-only | yes | mock ([unit](#mysql-unit)) | SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL and START TRANSACTION READ ONLY. Not run against a server. |
| Row locks | partial | ci-native ([locks](#mysql-locks)) | update and share only. |
| Streaming | yes | ci-native ([stream](#mysql-stream)) |  |
| Upsert (core) | yes | ci-native ([writes](#mysql-writes)) | ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE has no conflict target, so Turbine looks the row up first when create could collide on another unique key. |
| createMany and returned rows (core) | partial | ci-native ([writes](#mysql-writes)) | A plain createMany returns [] (no RETURNING). With onConflict the rows are read back by the conflict key. |
| JSON | yes | ci-native ([values](#mysql-values)) |  |
| Arrays | no | mock ([unit](#mysql-unit)) | Refused with E017. |
| Enums | partial | ci-native ([introspection](#mysql-introspection)) | Exact catalog labels generate literal unions. Suspect question marks on supplementary-capable or unknown character sets withhold labels and generate string; declare enums or columnTypes explicitly for exact types. |
| Binary | yes | ci-native ([values](#mysql-values)) |  |
| Views | no | none | Introspection reads base tables only and the CLI refuses --include-views. |
| Introspection and generate | yes | ci-native ([introspection](#mysql-introspection)) |  |
| Migrations | yes | ci-native ([lifecycle](#mysql-lifecycle)) | MySQL DDL is not transactional. |
| Seeds | yes | ci-native ([lifecycle](#mysql-lifecycle)) |  |
| Studio | no | none | MySQL project commands do not include studio. |
| Doctor | yes | ci-native ([tools](#mysql-tools)) |  |
| MCP read-only tools | yes | ci-native ([tools](#mysql-tools)) |  |
| Pipeline batching | yes | ci-native ([transactions](#mysql-transactions)) |  |
| LISTEN / NOTIFY | no | mock ([unit](#mysql-unit)) | Refused with E017. |
| Row-level security session context | no | mock ([unit](#mysql-unit)) | Refused with E017. |
| pgvector | no | mock ([unit](#mysql-unit)) | Refused with E017. |

<a id="serverless"></a>

## Edge and serverless (supplied pool)

**Experimental.** The PostgreSQL client bound to a pool you supply, built for edge runtimes. CI checks the bundle and the binding with a recording pool; no job runs it against a database through a provider driver.

- Import: `turbine-orm/serverless`
- Driver: Any pg-compatible pool you pass to turbineHttp (Neon, Vercel Postgres, Hyperdrive and others)

What Supported still needs:

- Typed queries: evidence is mock, needs ci-native
- Nested relation reads: evidence is mock, needs ci-native
- Nested writes: evidence is none, needs ci-native
- Transactions and savepoints: evidence is mock, needs ci-native
- Upsert: evidence is none, needs ci-native
- createMany and returned rows: evidence is none, needs ci-native

### Versions

Tested in CI:

- Edge bundle check: the serverless entry bundles under edge conditions with no pg import (no runtime, no database) (job `build`)

Not tested:

- Every provider driver and edge runtime against a database

### Features

| Feature | Support | Evidence | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Typed queries (core) | yes | mock ([binding](#serverless-binding)) | The PostgreSQL client. A supplied node-postgres pool is exercised natively on the PostgreSQL route. |
| Nested relation reads (core) | yes | mock ([binding](#serverless-binding)) |  |
| Relation load strategies | yes | none | Same code as PostgreSQL. Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| Nested writes (core) | yes | none | Needs a pool that can hold a transaction. Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| Transactions and savepoints (core) | yes | mock ([binding](#serverless-binding)) | Needs a pool that can hold a connection for the transaction. |
| Isolation levels and read-only | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| Row locks | yes | none | Needs a transaction-capable pool. Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| Streaming | partial | none | Needs a connection that can hold a cursor. HTTP drivers cannot. |
| Upsert (core) | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| createMany and returned rows (core) | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| JSON | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| Arrays | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| Enums | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| Binary | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| Views | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| Introspection and generate | no | none | Generate on Node against a direct connection. |
| Migrations | no | none | Run migrations on Node against a direct connection. |
| Seeds | no | none | Run seeds on Node. |
| Studio | no | none | A Node CLI command. |
| Doctor | no | none | A Node CLI command. |
| MCP read-only tools | no | none | A Node CLI command. |
| Pipeline batching | partial | none | Needs a connection that supports pipelining. |
| LISTEN / NOTIFY | partial | none | Needs a persistent connection. HTTP drivers cannot. |
| Row-level security session context | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |
| pgvector | yes | none | Not exercised through a provider driver. |

- <a id="serverless-binding"></a>**binding** (mock, unit suite): Queries, transactions and lifecycle over an in-memory recording pool.
  Files: `src/test/serverless.test.ts`

### Known limitations

- What works depends on the supplied pool: HTTP drivers cannot hold a cursor, a transaction or a LISTEN connection.

- Remote URLs and sync settings are refused.
- Introspected relations derive as on PostgreSQL, except edge cases in reading the constraint names of composite foreign keys that share a target: [Relation names across engines](relation-names.md#known-differences).
- A unique foreign key stays to-many when the child table's or its unique index's DDL contains COLLATE, or the parent's does and the referenced key is not the rowid alias, because column collations are not in the catalog.

| Transactions and savepoints (core) | partial | ci-native ([integration](#powdb-embedded-integration)) | Single writer; concurrent transactions queue. Nested tx.$transaction refuses with E017. |
| Isolation levels and read-only | partial | none | Read-only snapshots (0.14+) instead of read-only transactions. |
| Row locks | no | none | Refused with E017. |
| Streaming | no | ci-native ([integration](#powdb-embedded-integration)) | Refused with E017. |
| Upsert (core) | yes | ci-native ([integration](#powdb-embedded-integration)) |  |
| createMany and returned rows (core) | partial | ci-native ([integration](#powdb-embedded-integration)) | Rows returned. onConflict is refused. |
| JSON | yes | ci-native ([integration](#powdb-embedded-integration)) | Pathless equals and contains refuse with E017. |
| Arrays | no | none | Refused. |
| Enums | yes | none | Stored as str holding the label. |
| Binary | no | none | No bytes type is emitted. |
| Views | no | none | Not available. |
| Introspection and generate | partial | none | describe-based catalog read with no relations; defineSchema stays the relation-aware path. |
| Migrations | no | none | powqlSchemaDDL emits DDL; no migration runner. |
| Seeds | no | none | Not available. |
| Studio | no | none | Not available. |
| Doctor | no | none | Not available. |
| MCP read-only tools | no | none | Not available. |
| Pipeline batching | no | none | build methods throw E017. |
| LISTEN / NOTIFY | no | none | Refused with E017. |
| Row-level security session context | no | none | Refused with E017. |
| pgvector | no | ci-native ([integration](#powdb-embedded-integration)) | Refused with E017. |

### Evidence

- <a id="powdb-embedded-integration"></a>**integration** (ci-native, jobs `powdb-integration`; guard `TURBINE_REQUIRE_ENGINE: powdb`): Reads, many-to-many relations, nested writes with rollback, single-writer transactions, upserts, createMany, JSON and doc-field indexes.
  Files: `src/test/powdb.integration.test.ts`
- <a id="powdb-embedded-oracle"></a>**oracle** (ci-native, jobs `powdb-integration`; guard `TURBINE_REQUIRE_ENGINE: postgres,powdb`): The same operations on PostgreSQL and embedded PowDB must agree.
  Files: `src/test/oracle-engines-powdb.test.ts`

### Known limitations

- Rows over about 4070 bytes are refused by the embedded engine.
- Prebuilt addon for macOS arm64 and x64 and Linux glibc only.

<a id="powdb-networked"></a>

## PowDB (networked)

**Maintenance.** PowDB over TCP to a powdb-server. Maintenance mode. No CI job runs a server.

- Import: `turbine-orm/powdb`
- Driver: @zvndev/powdb-client, optional peer (>=0.7.1 <1.0.0)
- Evidence alone would earn: Preview

What Supported still needs:

- Typed queries: evidence is local-native, needs ci-native
- Nested relation reads: evidence is local-native, needs ci-native
- Nested writes: evidence is local-native, needs ci-native
- Transactions and savepoints: evidence is local-native, needs ci-native
- Upsert: evidence is local-native, needs ci-native
- createMany and returned rows: evidence is local-native, needs ci-native

### Versions

Tested in CI:

- Nothing.

Drivers:

- @zvndev/powdb-client 0.20.0 (package-lock.json)

Outside CI:

- The networked suite runs when POWDB_URL points at a server.

Not tested:

- Every powdb-server version in CI

## Exports that are not engine routes

| Import | Why it has no row |
| --- | --- |
| `turbine-orm/sql` | SQL fragment composition. It compiles with any engine's dialect and executes through that engine's client, so its support follows the route you run it on. |
| `turbine-orm/prisma-compat` | A Prisma-shaped surface over a TurbineClient. It adds no engine. |
| `turbine-orm/cli` | Configuration types for turbine.config.ts. The CLI's per-engine support is in the Migrations, Seeds, Studio, Doctor and MCP rows. |
| `turbine-orm/live-query` | Notification-driven refetch over PostgreSQL LISTEN / NOTIFY. See the LISTEN / NOTIFY row. |
| `turbine-orm/notification-hub` | A shared LISTEN connection for PostgreSQL. See the LISTEN / NOTIFY row. |
| `turbine-orm/core` | The driver-neutral client for a transport you supply. It has no engine of its own: support depends on the transport, and the D1 route is the one built on it. |
